📦 **Blockside `8bd8309`** — Fix ratline tube stride-6 VBO and rig model origin placement in shipRise

Refs TASK-1350

- shipRiseBuildTubeGpu: upload ropeTube vertices with stride 6
  ([[0, 3, 0], [2, 3, 3]]) and count TB.length / 6 instead of stride 9
  (MESH_ATTR), and draw tubeGpu under the unlit (uLit=0) pass alongside
  lineGpu so ratline vertices do not stretch white fan triangles to (0,0,0).
- shipRiseAnalyze / shipRiseDrawRig / shipRiseModelBox: include each
  model's m.origin translation (and exclude decos with m.gmod !== undefined
  as gunmounts) so rudders, anchors, and fixtures mount at their ship
  coordinates instead of sitting on the slipway dock at local (0,0,0).
- Rebuild index.html (5.57 MB, core 6001fdac75613e3e).

👥 參與者：@ridge-001

---
